document.title: Real Estate Withholding Statement
document.notes: California Franchise Tax Board, not the IRS. It accompanies a real-estate sale and is read beside the settlement statement — the withholding it reports is a CALIFORNIA payment, and putting it on a federal line is the category error E19 exists to refuse. The federal consequence of the same sale arrives on Form 1099-S, which this map does declare and does route. Box ids here are slugs rather than printed line numbers: the 2025 form's Part VI line numbering was not read against the printed form for this build, and inventing a line number would be a claim this map cannot support. The labels ARE what the form prints.

extraction.note: Out of this map's jurisdiction (US-CA). Classifiable so it can be named and held; deliberately not extracted federally.
